notes: Appendix I. The file “spore_color_species_list.xlsx” consists of three sheets: The first sheet "All_species" contains a complete list with all the taxa found with references on their spore color. + indicates references mentioning spores with green plastids, ++ indicates spores with chloroplasts. The second sheet "Genera" contains a list of fern families and genera summarizing the numbers of species with reports on achlorophyllous spores (AC), chlorophyllous spores (C), and cryptochloropyllous spores (CC). (+) Includes species with contradictory or ambiguous descriptions. Also given are total species number per genus, and percentage of species with information on spore color (% Described). The list excludes subspecies and varieties. The third sheet "Colors" includes a table listing the color categories and their frequencies found in the review. The file “literature_cited.docx” contains the complete list of references cited on the species list of the first sheet of the file “spore_color_species_list.xlsx”
